observations.behavior: Adds a cleanup path: after a failed write, it records the location and pending status, then attempts deletion; if deletion fails, it logs and keeps the row; if deletion succeeds, it deletes the row.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes cleanup behavior: instead of immediately deleting the row on write failure, it records a pending location and attempts cleanup, retaining metadata if deletion fails. This could preserve diagnostic metadata while still removing the object, or retain the row if cleanup fails, depending on implementation and settings.
